title: "Risk-Score Survival Overview"
author:

---

A multigene prognostic signature earns its keep in one composite figure: patients ranked by **risk score**, their survival outcomes beside them, and the underlying expression pattern below — three panels sharing a single left-to-right patient order, so the reader sees the score, the deaths, and the signature move together \[1\]. The reference builds this with cowplot from a LASSO-Cox output table \[2\]; this tutorial reproduces the layout with patchwork on a simulated signature:

## Example

![](../images/RiskScorePlot_demo.png){fig-alt="Risk-Score Survival Overview DEMO" fig-align="center" width="60%"}

## Setup

-   System Requirements: Cross-platform (Linux/MacOS/Windows)

-   Programming language: R

-   Dependent packages: `ggplot2`; `patchwork`

```{r packages setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, output=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
})
```

```{r}
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")
```

## Data Preparation

150 simulated patients with an 8-gene expression matrix (four risk genes, four protective), a risk score from planted coefficients, and Weibull survival times whose hazard scales with the score. All panels downstream sort by `order(riskscore)` and never re-sort:

```{r load data}
set.seed(14101)
n <- 150; n_gene <- 8
genes <- sprintf("SIG%d", 1:n_gene)
## signature: half protective, half risk — planted so high score = worse outcome
coef <- c(0.9, 0.7, -0.8, -0.6, 0.5, 0.4, -0.5, -0.3)
expr <- matrix(rnorm(n * n_gene, 0, 1), n, n_gene, dimnames = list(NULL, genes))
riskscore <- as.vector(expr %*% coef) + rnorm(n, 0, 0.4)
rk <- order(riskscore)
riskscore <- riskscore[rk]; expr <- expr[rk, ]
risk <- ifelse(riskscore >= median(riskscore), "High-risk", "Low-risk")
## survival: higher risk -> shorter time, more events
u <- runif(n)
lam <- exp(1.1 * scale(riskscore)[, 1])
times <- pmin(120, qweibull(u, shape = 1, scale = 120 / lam))
status <- rbinom(n, 1, pmin(0.9, pmax(0.02, 0.35 + 0.35 * scale(riskscore)[, 1])))

rs_data <- data.frame(x = 1:n, rs = riskscore, Risk = risk)
sv_data <- data.frame(x = 1:n, t = times,
                      Status = factor(ifelse(status == 0, "Alive", "Dead"),
                                      levels = c("Alive", "Dead")))
```

## Visualization

### 1. Score / Outcome / Expression, One Ordering

The composite: the dashed line marks the median-risk split; high-risk patients (red, right) die earlier and cluster at short survival times; the heatmap's saturated strip row encodes the group so the expression pattern reads against it:

```{r}
#| label: fig-1.1RiskTriple
#| fig-cap: "Risk-score overview of a simulated 8-gene prognostic signature: patients ranked by ascending risk score with the median split (dashed); survival status beside it; row-scaled, winsorized signature expression with a group strip below — all three panels share one patient ordering."
#| out.width: "75%"
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 9

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(patchwork))
nlow <- sum(rs_data$Risk == "Low-risk")
red <- "#DC0000FF"; teal <- "#00A087FF"

plot.A <- ggplot(rs_data, aes(x, rs)) +
  geom_point(aes(col = Risk), size = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = nlow, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`High-risk` = red, `Low-risk` = teal), name = "Risk score") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(y = "Risk score", x = NULL, title = "Risk-score stratification (simulated signature)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

plot.B <- ggplot(sv_data, aes(x, t)) +
  geom_point(aes(col = Status), size = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = nlow, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Alive = teal, Dead = red), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(y = "Survival time (months)", x = "Patients (ranked by risk score)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

## heatmap: row-scaled expression winsorized to [-1,1], rows clustered;
## the appended +/-1.5 group row reads the saturated strip colours
tmp <- t(scale(expr)); tmp[tmp > 1] <- 1; tmp[tmp < -1] <- -1
hc <- hclust(dist(tmp), method = "average"); tmp <- tmp[hc$order, ]
tmp <- rbind(tmp, Group = ifelse(rs_data$Risk == "Low-risk", -1.5, 1.5))
hm <- data.frame(gene = rep(rownames(tmp), n), patient = rep(seq_len(n), each = nrow(tmp)),
                 value = as.vector(tmp))
hm$gene <- factor(hm$gene, levels = rownames(tmp))
plot.C <- ggplot(hm, aes(patient, gene, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = teal, mid = "white", high = red, midpoint = 0,
                       name = "Expression\n(Z)") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

plot.A / plot.B / plot.C + plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 1, 1.5))
```

::: callout-tip
**Practice tips**

-   **One ordering, three panels**: every panel must derive its x positions from the same `order(riskscore)` — if the heatmap re-sorts columns (it clusters rows, never columns), the expression readout describes different patients than the dots.
-   Winsorize row-scaled expression to [-1, 1] **before** appending the ±1.5 group row — that headroom is what makes the strip's colours saturate past the data's range in the same colour scale.
-   The median split is the weakest link: report the score's Cox p-value / C-index alongside, and prefer a pre-specified or data-driven cutpoint (X-tile, maximally selected rank statistics) over a silent median when the group sizes matter clinically.
:::

## Applications

::: {#fig-RiskScoreApplications1}
![](../images/RiskScorePlot_demo.png){fig-alt="Risk-score / survival / expression overview" fig-align="center" width="60%"}

Risk-score / survival / expression overview
:::

Any ranked-patient overview re-uses this stack: immunotherapy response scores with PFS status, CNV burden scores with subtype, or pathology-slide risk with recurrence — as long as one patient ordering ties the panels together.
